title: Safe space to share your “craziest” or most abstract mallworld theories?

classification.question_topic: Inviting users to share Mall World theories; asking whether others are not lucid / lack autonomy in Mall World dreams and experience mixed 1st/3rd-person perspective
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream scene/location narrative to extract; only general meta-description of lucidity/autonomy and perspective.

interactions.description: Reports typical Mall World dream phenomenology: often not entirely lucid; may have a faint sense it’s not real; has little/no autonomy and the dream 'is all playing out' while they 'roll with the punches'. Also experiences dream in both 3rd- and 1st-person perspective ('watching it play out like a movie' and also 'through the eyes of me/the character').

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is primarily a prompt for theories plus a general question about lucidity/autonomy and perspective in Mall World dreams; no describable locations, movements, boundaries, entities, or events within a particular dream episode.
